artifact_reason: The TeamMembership.owner field (the fact that would disqualify Mia as a mere member, not owner) cannot be read through this replica's API. Every attempt to fetch it fails: `teams.memberships.nodes` and `.edges` both error 'Cannot return null for non-nullable field' (steps 11-16), even filtered to just t-des (step 12), and the singular `team.membership(userId:"u-mia")` resolver returns null instead of the membership object (step 19). With no working query surface for `owner`, the solver could not verify the deciding condition and guessed from indirect signals (sole member + admin) instead.
note: Solver correctly found the Design team (parent: null) and its sole member Mia Wong, then exhaustively tried every documented and introspected path to read TeamMembership.owner (steps 11, 12, 13, 16, 17, 19), all of which errored or returned null due to a replica resolver bug, forcing it to infer ownership rather than confirm it.
